Business Analyst
Freshworks
Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India (On-site)

About Freshworks:
Freshworks makes business software people love for customer service and IT.

Responsibilities:
• Analyze sales pipeline velocity, customer churn, and ARR expansion.
• Build automated dashboards using SQL, Tableau, and Salesforce CRM.
• Support bizops leaders with competitive analysis and pricing benchmarks.

Requirements:
• 1-2 years of experience as a business analyst or data analyst.
• Strong SQL, Excel, and problem-solving skills.
• Bachelor's degree in engineering or business.
• Based in Chennai office.
